extraction.Name: James Two Horse or Quigley
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 25, 1920 by the Kilgore State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Two Horse or Quigley and wife conveyed to Fred Hoffman for consideration of $5500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739625 issued; Southwest quarter, section 17, township 35, north of range 32; receipt signed April 2, 1920; deed conveyed May 4, 1920
